manifest.title: План на день
manifest.summary: Простой список дел с прогрессом и сохранением. Работает без сети и без запросов к ИИ.
manifest.summary_en: A simple task list with progress and persistence. Works offline without AI requests.
manifest.author: MemuAI

files.style.css: body{margin:0;background:var(--bg,#17191d);color:var(--text,#eee);font:14px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}.focus{max-width:680px;margin:auto;padding:28px}h1{font-size:26px;line-height:1.3;margin:0}header p,#empty,#count{color:var(--muted,#a5acb8)}form{margin:25px 0}label{display:block;margin-bottom:7px}.input-row{display:flex;gap:8px}input,button{font:inherit;color:inherit;border:1px solid var(--border,#48505c);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel,#262a32);padding:9px 12px}input{min-width:0;flex:1}button{cursor:pointer}button:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#9894f7)}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#9894f7);outline-offset:3px}ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:15px 0}li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#48505c)}li input{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px}li span{flex:1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}li.done span{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--muted,#a5acb8)}li button{padding:5px 10px}progress{display:block;width:100%;height:6px;margin-top:8px;accent-color:var(--accent,#9894f7)}#status{min-height:1.6em;color:var(--muted,#a5acb8);font-size:12px}button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}@media(max-width:420px){.focus{padding:18px}.input-row{flex-wrap:wrap}.input-row input{flex-basis:180px}}
